question: Should maintainers wait for the contributor to refresh this conflicting fork, or open a credited replacement branch that ports the accountId fix to current main?
rationale: The code direction is useful, but the uneditable conflicting branch, missing real delivery proof, and moved source-delivery seam require a human choice about the landing path before automation can safely proceed.

options.title: Port Or Replace On Current Main
options.body: Open or request a current-main port that preserves the contributor credit, fixes the stale seam, removes the changelog edit, updates docs, and gathers real delivery proof.

options.title: Wait For Contributor Refresh
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, enable maintainer edits, add the docs/proof, and remove the changelog entry before this exact branch is reconsidered.

options.title: Close After A Replacement Lands
options.body: Keep this PR open only until a proof-positive replacement becomes the safe landing path, then close this branch as superseded.

recommendation.title: Port Or Replace On Current Main
recommendation.body: Open or request a current-main port that preserves the contributor credit, fixes the stale seam, removes the changelog edit, updates docs, and gathers real delivery proof.
